# std/*.mind MANIFEST — the single committed source of truth for "which std
# modules does each consumer link".
#
# enforced-by: STDLIB-MANIFEST  (examples/mindc_mind/stdlib_manifest_lint.py)
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# -------------------
# This membership used to live as SEVENTEEN hand-copied literal lists (one in
# src/bin/mindc.rs::run_native_backend_bridge, sixteen in examples/mindc_mind/*.py)
# plus a fourth, DIFFERENT list in src/project/stdlib.rs, with nothing asserting
# any of them agreed. Two hand-copied lists that must agree, with no check, is the
# most common defect class in this tree. This manifest is the checked contract;
# the lint recomputes every consumer's real membership and fails on drift in BOTH
# directions, with positive counts.
#
# EXHAUSTIVE OVER std/*.mind — like `profile_frozen_admits` in
# src/ir/frozen_profile.rs, there is NO wildcard row. Every file in std/ must
# appear here exactly once. A NEW std module is therefore a hard lint FAILURE
# until someone records a deliberate in/out decision for each consumer, rather
# than being silently absent from both.
#
# COLUMNS  (tab-separated)
#   module       basename of std/<module>.mind
#   native_seed  seed | no   — is this module in the std blob the native backend
#                              bridge feeds to the frozen pure-MIND stage1.elf?
#   bundled      bundled | no — is this module in STDLIB_MIND_SOURCES, the
#                              include_str! bundle that resolves `use std.<m>`
#                              (feature = "cross-module-imports")?
#
# ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. Readers take the `native_seed` rows IN FILE ORDER; that
# order is the byte order of the std blob the FROZEN stage1.elf was minted from.
# Reordering, adding or removing a `seed` row changes the compiled bytes of every
# native build — a whole-corpus RESEED event, never a routine edit. The lint pins
# this with a positive golden below.
#
# SEED_BLOB_SHA256 199f304b1209959946d67bde175407719f9641bb423aa6c95fa8245d259cb202
#   sha256 of b"".join(read(std/<m>.mind) + b"\n" for each `seed` row in file
#   order) = the exact stdin image prefix the bridge composes. Recompute with:
#     python3 examples/mindc_mind/stdlib_manifest_lint.py --print-seed-sha256
#
# SEED_COUNT 21
# BUNDLED_COUNT 25
# TOTAL_COUNT 44
#
# 19 modules are `no`/`no`: on disk, reachable by NEITHER consumer. That is not an
# oversight recorded here to be forgotten — it is the measured gap behind RI matrix
# row 14 STDLIB_LINKING staying PARTIAL. See docs/RI_DEPENDENCY_MATRIX.md row 14.
#
# module	native_seed	bundled
